put.description:
Creates a pickup request. Integration with this endpoint can be tested by using the value "TESTING" in the CustomerReferenceNumber property. By using the TESTING value a pickup will NOT be created in the Dayton Freight pickup system and the fake pickup number XXX-1234 will be returned. Creating a pickup generates a "Pickup Number" (e.g. DAY-123456) that encompasses all of the shipments contained within the pickup request. Each shipment (sometimes referred to as an item or line item) within the pickup is given a unique identifier called the "Pickup Shipment ID", abbreviated as "PSID". Both the Pickup Number or a shipment's PSID can be used to track the progress of the pickup on the TrackByNumbers endpoint.
Pickup Requirements and Restrictions
Times should be in shipper’s local time without a time zone indicator in the following format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss
The Ready datetime cannot be prior to the current local date and time.
The Ready datetime cannot be after 5:00pm local time.
The Ready datetime must be at least 2 hours before the provided Close datetime.
Pickups cannot be scheduled on holidays or weekends.
The Ready datetime must be within 45 days of the current date.
A minimum of 1 shipment must be specified.
Handling units on a shipment is required and must be an integer between 1 and 999 units.
Weight on a shipment is required and must be an integer between 1 and 40,000 pounds.
Comments, CustomerReferenceNumber, and PickupInstructions are concatenated in our pickup system and the total length of all 3 properties must be less than 230 characters.
Accessorials with Service Restrictions
Pickup Services
NOTAppointment Needed or Call Before
RESIPResidential Pickup
Delivery Services
AIRDELAirport
NOTAppointment Needed or Call Before
CCVDChicago Trade Show, Exhibition Hall
LIFTLiftgate Trailer for Delivery
RESIDResidential Delivery
CVDTrade Show
LIMITLimited Access (church, school, restaurant, etc.)
Shipment Characteristics
EXLG07 - EXLG20Overlength Freight 7-20 Feet

Tracks shipments using a parameter-value list of numbers. The type of number is specified by the type parameter.

Tracking by a pickup number or a pickup shipment id (PSID) will only return results once the shipments have been assigned PRO numbers and scanned by a Daytonfreight driver.

parameters.name: number
parameters.description:
Accepts either the Pro, Bill of Lading, Shipper number, PO number, Pickup number, or Pickup Shipment ID (PSID).
Number parameter should repeat for multiples.
Ex. number=XXXX&number=XXXX&number=XXXXX

ApiRateHandlingUnit.description:
API request and response compatible RateHandlingUnit class.

A handling unit is the container for one or more items on the rate request.
Handling units are optional but provide customers the ability to be more specific about what is being shipped. 
Rates created on through the API can specify which items are on which handling units through the UserHandlingUnitPairingId property.
Rates created on the website will use the GUI to specify which items are on which handling units through the HandlingUnitPairingId property.

tags.name: Quick Start
tags.description:
1.) Obtain credentials

In order to get started with the REST API, you must have a daytonfreight.com username/password.If you do not have a web account, you can set one up on our website.
Create an Account

2.) Add accounts to your credentials

For REST API to authorize properly, the correct accounts must be associated to your web credentials.Please contact our apihelp@daytonfreight.com department to manage adding accounts to your web credentials.

3.) Enable web services

Once your web account is setup and authorized, you can enable web services by going to daytonfreight.com and navigating to 'My Account'. From 'My Account' select 'Update Account' and there you will find an option to 'Enable Web Services/Developer Integration?' Check this box and provide technical contact information.

4.) Add Authentication Headers to your HTTP Requests

Basic Authentication is used for all API requests. You will be adding an “Authorization” header to every request. This header will consist of three items, the static value “Basic” followed by a base64 encoded string that contains your user name and password separated by a colon. Since credentials are being sent with every request, using the SSL protocol is required when using Basic authentication. See example below.

Header before base64 encoding (this has to be encoded before it can be used):
Authorization: Basic username:password

Header after base64 encoding (this is what is actually used in the request):
Authorization: Basic dXNlcm5hbWU6cGFzc3dvcmQ=

5.) Execute requests

The rest of this documentation outlines each of our endpoint options, their required data elements and gives examples. Customers may “pull” data, but we do not currently offer a webhook/callback to push data from our REST API services.

The most common services used are:

  • GET Tracking/ByNumber – Get’s detailed shipment information/status for a shipment.
  • POST Rates – Returns rate estimates from inputted shipment characteristics.
  • PUT Pickup/Create – Creates a pickup request / load tender for us to pick freight up.

tags.name: Troubleshooting
tags.description:
401 / 403 / Unauthorized Errors


(may appear as an empty response)

Wrong Username or Password
  • Verify your login by trying to login to daytonfreight.com

Web Services Not Enabled
Your web account must have API access enabled:
  1. Go to My Account
  2. Select Update Account
  3. Check Enable Web Services / Developer Integration
  4. Enter technical contact information

Account Not Linked or Incorrect Account Used
  • The correct bill-to account(s) must be tied to your web login
  • If accounts are missing or incorrect, authorization will fail
  • Contact API Support to link accounts to your profile

Authorization Header Not Formatted Correctly
  • Each API request must include an Authorization header. The header should use Basic Authentication and follow this format:
    • Authorization: Basic <base64 encoded username:password>
  • Ensure the username and password are combined with a colon (username:password) and then base64 encoded before being sent.
  • While the website allows longer usernames, the API only accepts the first 10 characters.
    • Example: If your username is BestCustomer, use BestCustom when forming the authentication header.

Rating Issues



Non-Direct Rating (No Rate Returned)
  • This typically occurs when the shipment party responsible for payment is outside our service area.
    • Prepaid → Shipper must be in service area
    • Collect → Consignee must be in service area
  • Example issue:
    Prepaid shipment with a non-direct shipper will not return a rate
  • Solutions:
    • Adjust freight terms (Prepaid vs Collect), or
    • Contact Dayton Freight Pricing@daytonfreight.com Pricing@daytonfreight.com

Guaranteed Service Errors
  • Dayton Freight offers:
    • AM Guaranteed service for delivery before noon
    • PM Guaranteed service for delivery by 5 PM
  • If no guaranteed service is requested:
    • Available options will appear in upgradeOptions when applicable
  • Best practice:
    • Validate service availability before requesting a rate
      • Service Eligibility Tool: https://tools.daytonfreight.com/service/eligibility
      • Or use the Service Eligibility / Transit Times API

Accessorial Validation Issues
  • Ensure rating accessorials are valid and supported
  • Reference list: https://api.daytonfreight.com/api/Shipping/Accessorials

Tracking Issues



Shipment Not Found
  • Shipment data may not be available until the night of pickup
  • Early tracking attempts may return no results

Tracking Best Practices
  • Most reliable options:
    1. PRO Number
      • Standard tracking number once assigned
    2. PSID (Pickup Shipment ID)
      • Unique shipment-level identifier (1 to 1 with PRO)
      • Remains constant even if shipments are rescheduled or consolidated
      • Returned as shipments > id in the Create Pickup response
  • Less reliable options:
    • BOL Number
    • PO Number
    • Shipper Number
    • Pickup
These may not always be stored or searchable in the system

API Support



If you need additional assistance, please submit the API Support Form to connect with our team. Providing a full request and exact error response will significantly speed up troubleshooting.
